summary: Public projects created on 17 December 2024: 2 repos.
intro: Two repositories cover language model evaluation and agent tooling. One holds loosely organised experiments probing political censorship in large language models. The other is configuration for an assistant that redacts personally identifiable details in documents.

projects.name: Bias Censorship Eval Tests
projects.description: Some loosely organised experiments intended to probe the levels of political censorship inherent in LLMs

projects.name: Claude Anonymisation Assistant Plugin
projects.description: Configuration for a large language assistant designed to assist with redacting personally identifiable details in documents
